reason: This done=true verdict does not cover five blockers: empty-scratch varlen geometries raise AttributeError on geometry.scratch; native_batch.eligible was accepted with a BufferArg shape the legal conv2d texture pipeline cannot use; conv2d ablation has no fused GPU median and the Winograd direct fallback lacks a finite-U overflowing-transform case; the protocol, evaluation, and design docs still contradict the scratch texture contract; and archived P2-H/P3/P4 geometry identity was not replayed. original.summary: All four rejected blockers are closed on the uncommitted tree at 72a9c3a. host_written is passed through the production pair and preflight sites, uninitialized_poison coverage is a full-word replay with a sentinel-skip negative on both correctness and benchmark, the first poison producer refuses reflected readwrite, and the conv2d archive keeps full confirm subjects. The missed last-OC case stays unsafe; tcenv/evaluate.py is unchanged and the deviation is recorded. publication_allowed is false. There is no reuse of the rejected review, and this change is not committed.
checks: HEAD is 72a9c3a08986b51a366bfc489e34038b5983dec6. git status shows only uncommitted scratch work. The old verdict is only review-r1-rejected.json.

Blocker 1: geometry_pair and resolve_geometry still default host_program_present=False, but runner.py, portfolio_runner.py (preflight hook, selected resolve_geometry, second preflight_geometry, and the geometry_pair before evaluate_task), portfolio_confirmation.py, and dispatch.py's provider-aware preflight hook all pass host_tiling_entry(...) is not None. test_host_written_scratch_is_committed_through_evaluate_task goes through msl-bundle evaluate_task and MetalV2Executor: return 0 commits four fp32 1.0 values before dispatch; return 1 leaves 0xFF, pipeline_calls=0, dispatch_count=0. test_portfolio_host_written_scratch_passes_preflight_and_evaluate reaches evaluate. Both passed.

Blocker 2: v2_runtime._one_scratch_coverage paints every 4-byte word and _stale_words scans the whole aligned span; a stage encode is not treated as a rewrite. The residue probe keeps word 0 and requires the tail to change; the full probe replays max(2, timed iters) with a fresh poison pattern each round. correctness() runs that proof on the quick path after a clean numeric result, and benchmark() adds the same violations. test_sentinel_skip_fails_full_coverage_on_both_paths failed the sentinel-skip producer on both paths and passed the honest producer. Buffers under 8 bytes have no residue tail; that limit is stated in the design doc and is not the rejected one-byte check.

Blocker 3: stage_binding._scratch_argument refuses the first uninitialized_poison use unless declared access and reflected access are both write. reflection_for_kernel copies compiler access; ReadWrite stays readwrite and is not rewritten to write. test_first_poison_producer_reflected_readwrite_is_refused calls bind_pipeline_arguments with the first uwin reflected readwrite and expects GeometryError. The same reflection is accepted for device_zero. host_written is not in the poison-producer set, so buffer write+readwrite still binds.

Blocker 4: record_conv2d.py stores the confirm_candidate document as arm['subject'] and does not pop it. evidence/conv2d-ablation.json has three arms, each with search_report, confirmation_report, identity, and expected. verify_conv2d_ablation loads that file, calls verify_subject_document, recomputes the candidate sha from regenerated Metal source, and requires confirmed, search seed 7, confirmation seed != 7, and report status/correctness/safety ok. Seeds are 8365076480004115, 2234843515264388, and 6964540162819389. run_confirmation_gpu runs tests/backends/metal/test_conv2d_scratch_gpu.py with expected=5, and that file has those five tests. publication_allowed is false. The full P2-I verifier in terminals/902996.txt exited 0 and printed the conv2d subject-replay line.

Missed last OC: test_a_missed_last_oc_write_is_refused asserts status unsafe. git diff tcenv/evaluate.py is empty, so the safety-before-correctness order is unchanged. The deviation from the M2 'incorrect' wording is explicit in docs/架构/中间结果复用与Scratch Workspace.md and P2-I/I.md. Partial U write remains incorrect; the out-of-bounds store remains unsafe.
